name: Swim for Life: 2022 to current
description:
This dataset records individual Swim for Life swimming instruction classes offered from 2022 onward, with each row representing one class session. It includes participant counts broken out as male, female, and not designated; the training entity (NYC Parks for all rows); the training site; the borough (Manhattan, Queens, or Brooklyn); an adaptive class flag; the class start time; and a descriptive class name. Most rows have no missing values, though the borough field is blank for about 20% of records and the adaptive class field is entirely empty in the sample.

The data can be used to track enrollment and participation by gender across sites and boroughs, compare demand among training locations, monitor how often classes are scheduled over time, and examine the reach of adaptive swimming offerings. It also supports planning and equity analyses for public recreation programs, such as identifying underserved areas or evaluating how municipal aquatics facilities are used.
